history.summary: Old (1998) 99yr 3BR at Hougang Green (D19) at a very low $1.2M / $1052 PSF, near the $1012 district median. Headline 7.63% CAGR looks great but rests on just 22 transactions, and the development is 28 years old with only an LRT (not MRT) ~950m away.
history.rating_rationale: The cheap quantum ($1.2M) and HDB-upgrader appeal in D19 give a deep buyer pool, and PDD/CRL is a long-run D19 catalyst. But the 7.63% CAGR is built on only 22 txns (low reliability), the property is 28 years old on a 99yr lease (~71yr left, financing/lease-decay drag), and access is via Renjong LRT 950m away, not an MRT. Affordable and liquid at the low end, but ageing-lease risk and thin appreciation data cap it at Neutral.
red_flags: 1998 build, ~71yr lease remaining — lease decay and ageing-stock resale drag
7.63% CAGR rests on only 22 txns — unreliable rate
LRT access only (950m to Renjong LRT), no direct MRT
catalysts: Sub-$1.2M 3BR — strong HDB-upgrader demand and deep buyer pool
Punggol Digital District + CRL lifting the broader D19 over the hold
